content.short: DaemonSprites is a Cardano NFT project using collectible access keys for private AI chat experiences.
content.description: DaemonSprites is a Cardano NFT project that combines digital collectibles with access to AI chat experiences. The name joins daemon, a background computer process, with sprite, a two-dimensional game image, reflecting the project's mix of software culture and pixel-style identity. Holders can use NFTs as keys for AI conversations, with the project emphasizing privacy and ledger-based access rather than storing conversations. DaemonSprites explores how Cardano NFTs can unlock interactive utility beyond static artwork.
